honesty_note: Statuses describe BioNexus adapters and committed fixtures, not vendor certification, live cluster runs, or scientific warrant. Native R objects and live nf-core executions are out of the Python core runtime.

status_vocabulary.FIXTURE_VERIFIED: CI exercises committed lab-like fixtures through import, envelope validation, capsule export, and standards projection.
status_vocabulary.EXPORTED_ARTIFACT_VERIFIED: Vendor runtime is not executed; BioNexus verifies the community export the lab actually hands over (MTX/TSV/h5ad/CSV).
status_vocabulary.DECLARED: Adapter or detection exists; no committed fixture currently proves the path.
status_vocabulary.LIVE_VENDOR_UNVERIFIED: A live vendor binary or pipeline run has not been executed in BioNexus CI.
status_vocabulary.UNSUPPORTED: Explicitly out of scope. Import is refused.

limitations: AnnData parse requires the goldchain extra; without anndata the .h5ad file is hashed, not opened.
rank_genes_groups tables are not condition DE.
Native .rds/.qs Seurat objects are UNSUPPORTED in the Python runtime.
Labs must export MTX/TSV or h5ad (SeuratDisk/sceasy) before import.
Imports result tables; does not re-run DESeq2 or PyDESeq2.
Imports result tables; does not execute edgeR in R.
Does not invoke the Cell Ranger binary.
filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 is hashed when present; MTX is the required fixture path.
Import inspects results directories; it does not launch Nextflow.
Live nextflow/nf-core binaries remain LIVE_VENDOR_UNVERIFIED in CI.
Workflow success is not scientific warrant.
